(i) Deterministic scalar formulas. Their exact mean nodes can be ordered as M1, . . . , MQ, where Mi = uEi,ri , Ei = bi + X j<i aijMj, Ef = bf + X j afjMj. (6.20) All aij and afj are deterministic scalars. The whole node list, its scales, and these coefficients can be formed without knowing a mean value or making an oracle query. (ii) Direct terms and scales. Each node has ri = rτi and τi = q 1 − ρ2 i ≥ R/ √ 5, bi = x + r(ℓiy + miG). For CS, the G term is absent, ρi ≤ ρe, and (ℓi, mi) = (ρi, 0).
